summary: Rebuilds a scene linked list from a global scene array. Clears the existing list via LinkedListDestructionWithVTableCall, reads the scene count from dword_8AC488, then iterates the scene array at dword_8AC490 (stride 396, scene name string at entry+4). For each entry it copies the name, trims to the last path separator (backslash 92), formats the filename portion with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck using the format table at off_5C6660, loads/creates the scene object via sub_497AD0 (falling back to the string at off_5C665C when the load returns zero), and appends the node with LinkedListNodeAppend.
